reason: A DeepSeek Harness development utility that watches installed plugins, reloads changed code in place, reports watch status, and signals dependency changes for supervised restarts.

summaries.zh: 用于 DeepSeek Harness 的插件热重载工具，可监视已安装插件变化、手动重新加载插件并在依赖树变化时配合监督进程重启。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness utility that watches installed plugins, reloads changed code in place, supports manual reload commands, and signals dependency-tree changes for supervised restarts.

capabilities: polls installed plugin entry and package metadata files
hot-reloads plugin modules and remounts their runtime components
provides manual reload and watch-status commands
exits with a configurable code when plugin dependency metadata changes
rolls back failed reloads to the previous plugin state
